items.title: GPS freezes on WB11F0162
items.detail: The position stopped changing for 24 minutes while the truck was moving on NH19.
items.advice: Check the GPS antenna cable; if it continues, the dealer can replace the module.

evidence.text: Position unchanged for 24 min on NH19

items.title: FleetEdge account stopped sending data
items.detail: No report from 4 trucks on this account since 1 Nov, 9:00 am.
items.advice: Re-link the account so live data comes back.
